  b.  Landscape Manager/Supervisor Report
  Mr. Farmer stated on the new pickleball request for bid packet is
  completed with the new location and specification details, pending
  for final City Council approval and communicated on the Via Verde
  playground pad getting replaced due to damage in the upcoming
  weeks.

  Mr. Perez provided an overview and discussed the current ballfield
  conditions and current process for continued maintenance
  throughout the year that includes coordinating with the recreation
  department due to field rentals and programming.
  The Landscape crew consists of a 5- person crew and maintenance
  includes turf, irrigation, tree trimming and parr checks.
  inclement weather adds to the maintenance and most of the times
  requires for ballfields to be closed due to safety and harsher
  conditions for the turf to be damaged from severe saturation.
  Mr. Farmer communicated the crew is responsible for arrogation of
  all fields and gofer holes as well.

  c.  Recreation Manager Report

  Mr. Jones discussed the following:
  the Recreation report attached that included the Cars and Coffee
  event, Music in the Park attendance and band performances and
  the City Birthday celebration.
  an overview of summer programming which is a very busy time for
  the department due to kids out of school season.
  Kids Fun Club is halfway point and camps are highly attended.
  National Night out event in collaboration with the San Dimas
  Sheriffs  department.
  Registrations  for the 5k event in September  has begun.

6.  Chair' s Report

  Chair Bartolo stated on the summer concert series and how enjoyable Wednesday
  nights  are.

  Chair Bartolo communicated on the possibility of having pickleball lessons added to
  the recreation programming now that the City has pickleball courts coming and if
  there were any Rodeo event updates from an interested group.

  Mr. Wasserman confirmed the Rodeo group is still interested but the group is
  working on establishing paperwork necessary.
